ns2:section.sectionTitle: I3:Incl Inquir Based SS for Il
ns2:section.sectionText: Modality: Hybrid: synchronous (via Zoom) and asynchronous (via Google classroom modules) Zoom Meeting Dates: 2/7/2023 and 3/14/2023 This professional learning series is open to K-12 teachers participating in the I3 intensive professional learning series. During the professional learning experience participating teachers will explore the revised Illinois inquiry-based Learning Standards and the Illinois Inclusive American History Mandates, complete reflective activities, and construct curricular and pedagogical tools that support more inquiry-based and inclusive learning experiences for students in K-12 classrooms.
